final: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tr2.transreg) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) as proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind
